notes: The note is not a paraphrase of any fixture: it computes feasible partial selections, identifies that the promoted cost schedule is a vendor-price span rather than a committed envelope, and notices that the A window and the C lead-time cutoff are already affected.

The note recovered the unpromoted technical attempt and its execution-world content through palimpsest_manage/palimpsest_status plus ordinary filesystem access. The continuation assessment was not a model-facing field; the Agent reasoned from the Work state, the journal and the repository.
The note states the head divergence: the repository is ahead of the project head; it does not claim a head reconciliation or a promotion that did not occur.
P.humanCoordination: one process stop after the turn; no manual explanation, restart or correction was needed to obtain a usable note

hypotheses.H4-R: PARTIAL — the expert kernel distinguishes EXACT, COMPATIBLE, INCOMPATIBLE and UNKNOWN from real observations with no fabricated positive. The packaged continuation face produces EXACT and INCOMPATIBLE only; its whole-repository read makes COMPATIBLE unreachable for a source change, and its origin-to-current diff can conflate a promoted result's own output with an external change.
hypotheses.H4-E: PARTIAL — exact reuse and normal promotion worked; the governed rework route was identified and the permit minted, but the D2 execution refused at HEAD_BASIS_MISMATCH after the external source updates; no rematerialization was offered.
hypotheses.H4-C: SUPPORTED for one P Session — a genuinely new DSH Session with an empty session store discovered the accepted cost result, the unpromoted technical attempt and its execution world, the journal, the external updates and the head divergence.
hypotheses.H4-I: NOT EXERCISED — the normal host composes Project Intent but supplies no admission authority and exposes no model-facing tool; no structured proposal or PROJECT_REVISED event occurred.
hypotheses.H4-A: PARTIAL — journal/project/manage/status tools work and the P Agent used them; the continuation assessment and the result content are not model-facing fields; the Agent recovered the technical result through ordinary filesystem access.
hypotheses.H4-V: NOT ESTABLISHED — the matched F baseline is BLOCKED by provider quota; no comparative value was measured. The P note is strong but is one run against no valid baseline.

limitations: One scored P run; F is blocked; no comparative or statistical claim.
The deterministic Work Result is produced by a test-owned worker, not a model; it exercises the Work/continuation mechanism, not cognitive quality.
The expert diagnostic used a test-owned instrumented read set; it is not the packaged first-party read footprint.
The external source updates are direct Git commits; the live head diverges from the canonical project head and the rework execution path refuses. This is reported, not repaired.
The P note uses ordinary filesystem access to the execution world; that is a real product capability, but it is not a model-facing continuation tool.
The provider quota failure is external to the budget monitor; no model tokens were spent on the blocked F turn.
